zenMode.label: Ignorance is Bliss
zenMode.description: Zen mode: Hides unread message counts to reduce anxiety.

strategicDelay.label: Strategic Delay
strategicDelay.description: Adds a 10-second delay before sending emails, allowing you to "Undo Send".

path.label: Data Path
path.description: The directory where all your mail, attachments and local database are stored.
path.alreadyCurrent: This is already your data path

migration.confirmDescription: This will move all your emails, attachments, and settings to the new location. The application will restart automatically after the migration is complete.
migration.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to move your data back to the default location?

privacy.title: Privacy Settings
privacy.subtitle: Control your data and how you're tracked.

shieldImages.label: Shield Images
shieldImages.description: Blocks external images by default to prevent tracking pixels.

blockReadReceipts.label: Block Read Receipts
blockReadReceipts.description: Never send read confirmations to senders.

disableLinkPreview.label: Disable Link Previews
disableLinkPreview.description: Don't fetch URL previews to prevent IP leaks.

stripMetadata.label: Strip Attachment Metadata
stripMetadata.description: Remove EXIF and other metadata from images before sending.

autoLock.label: Auto-lock
autoLock.description: Lock the app after a period of inactivity.

setupPin.title: Set up PIN
setupPin.description: Create a PIN to unlock the app when auto-lock is enabled.

encryptAttachments.label: Encrypt Attachments
encryptAttachments.description: Store downloaded attachments encrypted on disk.

clearClipboard.label: Clear Clipboard
clearClipboard.description: Auto-clear clipboard 30 seconds after copying sensitive data.

accentColor.title: Accent Color
accentColor.description: Used for buttons, highlights, and active states.

background.title: Background
background.description: Sets the base tone of the interface.

darkMode.label: Dark Mode
darkMode.description: Use dark theme across the application.

compactMode.label: Compact Mode
compactMode.description: Denser UI with smaller spacing for power users.

showAvatars.label: Show Avatars
showAvatars.description: Display contact avatars in the message list.

animations.label: Animations
animations.description: Enable smooth transitions and motion effects.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Control how you're notified about new mail.

desktop.label: Desktop Notifications
desktop.description: Show system notifications for new emails.

sound.label: Sound Alerts
sound.description: Play a sound when new email arrives.

count.label: Badge Count
count.description: Show unread count in dock or taskbar.

importantOnly.label: Important Only
importantOnly.description: Only notify for emails from starred contacts or marked as important.

readReceipts.label: Request Read Receipts
readReceipts.description: Ask for confirmation when recipients read your emails.
